description: Header file defining the AndroidVideoSurfaceChooserImpl class, which implements the AndroidVideoSurfaceChooser interface for managing video surface selection on Android within Chromium's media GPU component.

classes.name: AndroidVideoSurfaceChooserImpl
classes.description: Implementation of AndroidVideoSurfaceChooser managing surface switching logic for Android video playback.

methods.name: AndroidVideoSurfaceChooserImpl
methods.description: Constructor initializing surface chooser with dynamic switching permission and optional custom clock.

methods.name: SetClientCallbacks
methods.description: Sets callback functions for overlay and texture owner usage.

methods.name: UpdateState
methods.description: Updates internal state with new overlay factory and state information.

methods.name: Choose
methods.description: Decides whether to use overlay or texture owner based on current conditions.

methods.name: SwitchToTextureOwner
methods.description: Switches to using a TextureOwner for video surface.

methods.name: SwitchToOverlay
methods.description: Switches to using an overlay, optionally requiring power efficiency.

methods.name: OnPowerEfficientState
methods.description: Callback indicating overlay power efficiency state.
